settings.title: Block device fingerprinting
settings.summary: Stops FingerprintJS Pro from identifying this device to Kick when signed in. Sign-up and age checks use it and can fail while this is on.

settings.title: Clean share links
settings.summary: Removes known tracking parameters from Kick links you share; keeps functional parameters.

settings.title: Disable analytics
settings.summary: Turns off Firebase, Insider, Datadog, Mux, Datazoom and PAL. Kick's own requests, including playback, still run.

settings.title: Don't save searches
settings.summary: Don't add new searches to the search history.

settings.title: AMOLED black
settings.summary: A pure black background, optionally with near-black cards and sheets.

settings.title: Block update prompts
settings.summary: Never show Kick's update screens. Update by patching a newer version.

settings.title: Default startup tab
settings.summary: The screen Kick opens on. Following needs an account.

settings.title: Hide Clips
settings.summary: Hide Clips tabs and the channel clips row. Shared clip links still open.

settings.title: Hide KICKs tipping
settings.summary: Hide gift-shop, purchase and leaderboard tipping prompts. Received gifts still show.

settings.title: Hide categories
settings.summary: The top or recommended categories row.

settings.title: Hide celebration prompts
settings.summary: The celebration button in the chat footer.

settings.title: Hide event and drops banners
settings.summary: Drops campaign and event banners on the stream screen.

settings.title: Hide featured streams
settings.summary: The featured carousel at the top of Home.

settings.title: Hide goals
settings.summary: The channel goal card above chat.

settings.title: Hide host messages
settings.summary: Another channel hosting this one, in chat and as a card above it.

settings.title: Hide mature-content warning
settings.summary: Skip the 18+ warning on mature streams when signed out. Signed in, your account's age applies.

settings.title: Hide pinned KICKs
settings.summary: KICKs gifts pinned above chat.

settings.title: Hide pinned messages
settings.summary: The message pinned above chat.

settings.title: Hide polls and predictions
settings.summary: Poll and prediction cards above chat. You can't vote in hidden ones.

settings.title: Hide rating prompt
settings.summary: Never ask to rate Kick.

settings.title: Hide recommended streams
settings.summary: The recommended streams row (signed in).

settings.title: Hide reward redemptions
settings.summary: Viewers redeeming the channel's rewards, in chat.

settings.title: Hide sub and gift messages
settings.summary: New subs and gifted subs, in chat and as cards above it.

settings.title: Hide subscription upsells
settings.summary: Hide channel subscription buttons and the leaderboard gift prompt.

settings.title: Show exact counts
settings.summary: Viewer and follower counts in full instead of rounded.

settings.title: Stay on channel when it hosts
settings.summary: The host dialog waits instead of counting down. Watch now still switches.

settings.title: Background audio
settings.summary: Keep playing as audio when you leave Kick.

settings.title: Bypass VOD ad sessions (experimental)
settings.summary: Use the original VOD URL. Turn off if VOD or live rewind fails. Live ads are unaffected.

settings.title: Default video quality
settings.summary: Uses an adaptive 1080p default and Auto ceiling when available; player selections work normally.

settings.title: Disable autoplay
settings.summary: Default feed previews to off. Kick's saved preference takes precedence. Restart required.

settings.title: Fill screen
settings.summary: Zoom streams to fill the screen in landscape instead of showing bars at the sides, cropping their top and bottom. Not for vertical videos, next to the chat or in picture-in-picture.

settings.title: Mute stitched live ads
settings.summary: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. Mutes and blacks out an ad break Kick's player reports, until it ends. The ad still plays for its full length.

settings.title: No automatic picture-in-picture
settings.summary: Don't open the floating video when you leave Kick while watching.

settings.title: Normal latency
settings.summary: Turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers. Applies to streams opened afterwards.

settings.title: Quality on mobile data
settings.summary: The highest quality a stream starts at on metered networks. A quality you pick in the player still plays.

settings.title: Seek interval
settings.summary: How far rewind and forward skip in videos.

settings.title: Show video stats
settings.summary: A panel over the player with latency, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, quality and codecs, refreshed every second. Applies at once.

settings.title: Sleep timer
settings.summary: Pauses playback this long after it last started or resumed, including background audio.

settings.title: 7TV emotes
settings.summary: Shows 7TV in chat, picker and autocomplete. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io every 5 minutes and keeps a connection to events.7tv.io while chat is open, so 7TV can see which channels you watch and for how long.

settings.title: Anonymous chat
settings.summary: Read chat as a guest: the chat page gets no sign-in token or account. Sending messages is disabled while this is on.

settings.title: Chat keywords
settings.summary: Highlight and hide chat messages by the words and users below. Whole words, any case. Applies to chats opened afterwards.

settings.title: Highlight mentions
settings.summary: Tint messages that mention your username. Needs a signed-in account.

settings.title: Highlight words
settings.summary: Tint messages containing any of these words or phrases, separated by commas.

settings.title: Vibrate on highlights
settings.summary: Vibrate when a highlighted message arrives, at most every three seconds.

settings.title: Blocked words
settings.summary: Hide messages containing any of these words or phrases, separated by commas.

settings.title: Blocked users
settings.summary: Hide messages from these users (the name shown in chat or the kick.com/name handle), separated by commas.

settings.title: Chat text size
settings.summary: The size of chat text. Applies to chats opened afterwards.

settings.title: Chat timestamps
settings.summary: Show the time next to each chat message. Applies to chats opened afterwards.

settings.title: Compact chat
settings.summary: Less space between chat messages. Applies to chats opened afterwards.

settings.title: Ignore chat clears
settings.summary: Keep the messages when a moderator clears the chat. Timeouts and bans still apply. Applies to chats opened afterwards.

settings.title: Show deleted messages
settings.summary: Keep deleted, timed-out and banned messages, struck through, as moderators see them. Only the chat page on your phone changes; Kick's server sees nothing different. Applies to chats opened afterwards.

settings.title: Debug logging
settings.summary: Detailed lines in the system log for bug reports (adb logcat -s lurk). They can name the channels and videos you open.

settings.title: Lurk in account menu
settings.summary: A Lurk row in Kick's account menu opens this screen.
